title: Trapped in the Snow
sentences: A shortcut left eighty-seven pioneers trapped in mountain snow for an entire winter.
The Donner Party gambled on an untested route, the Hastings Cutoff, and fell behind.
By early November 1846, snow had sealed them in near Truckee Lake.
As food ran out, some of the starving ate the bodies of the dead.
Rescuers did not reach them until mid-February.
One was thirteen-year-old Virginia Reed, who wrote to her cousin: never take no cutoffs.
